messages:
Maya Patel: quick heads-up — ran a small bring-up of q4b->int4 on the qbringup branch; seeing a cluster of golden divergences on our summarization promptset. uploaded a sample subset to gs://redwood-curation/tmp/silo-a-2026-03-21.jsonl. thinking about siloing these into a separate relabel queue (silo-A) to avoid contaminating main bank — any objections? :thinking_face:

Soren Li: no objections, can you paste a couple of the examples that regressed? want to know if this is hallucination, truncation, or tokenization-related so we can triage root cause quickly.

Maya Patel: here are two quick snippets (trimmed):
```json
{"id":"abc123","prompt":"Summarize:
- item one
- item two
","expected":"A concise list of items","q4b":"A short answer","int4":"A short answer missing item two"}
{"id":"def456","prompt":"Describe the steps:
1) init
2) run
","expected":"step 1 then step 2","q4b":"step 1 then step 2","int4":"step 1"}
```
looks like trailing-list truncation in several cases.

Priya Rao: before we create relabel tasks, please run dedupe with fuzzyhash v2 — last relabel wave we ended up relabeling duplicates and burned golden credits. command: `python -m curation.tools.dedupe --bank silo-A --fuzzy v2`

Maya Patel: doing that now. also paging @Jorge Martinez for labeler capacity — estimate ~200 items after dedupe, maybe 48h of work at normal throughput.

Jorge Martinez: i can spare two labelers tomorrow afternoon. what's the QC pass criteria? we should avoid subjective rephrases becoming the new gold.

Priya Rao: QC: require 3 annotator agreement OR anchor to `golden_set/v5`. if disagreement >30% escalate to senior curation. also add a tokenizer-check step to the workflow.

qc-bot: QC check scheduled: 4390012352 - running golden compare pipeline for gs://redwood-curation/tmp/silo-a-2026-03-21.jsonl

Maya Patel: after dedupe run i see 182 unique items flagged. i'll stage them into a micro-golden relabel job and include the `golden_set/v5` anchors. i'll also run a quick hosted eval against the canary: `curl https://api.redwood.com/v1/bench -d '{"model":"q4b-int4-canary"}'` — will post bench summary when ready.

Soren Li: please also add a tokenizer mismatch check — we've seen v1->v2 tokenizer differences cause suffix truncation (see internal issue #3147). if any items show tokenization drift, convert to tokenizer v2 before labeling.

Maya Patel: noted, converting to v2 before handing off. will update thread with final relabel task link and counts. thanks :thumbsup:
